nodes.Name: DoublePanic
nodes.DocComment:
Test that panic message is not clobbered.
See issue 30150.

nodes.Name: exampleError
nodes.DocComment:
Test that panic while panicking discards error message
See issue 52257

nodes.Name: RepanickedPanicSandwich
nodes.DocComment:
Panic sandwich:

	panic("outer") =>
	recovered, panic("inner") =>
	panic(recovered outer panic value)

Exercises the edge case where we repanic a panic value,
but with another panic in the middle.

nodes.Name: DoublePanicWithSameValue
nodes.DocComment:
Double panic with same value and not recovered.
See issue 76099.
